item.title: D2C OpenAI plugin — diagrams with PlantUML, Mermaid, and D2
item.description: D2COpenAIPlugin is a ChatGPT plugin that turns conversation into PlantUML, Mermaid, or D2 without leaving the thread. I built it when OpenAI plugins were the main extension story — useful for architecture sketches, lab docs, and “draw this flow” moments in chat.

item.description:
D2COpenAIPlugin

Join the ChatGPT plugins waitlist here!

D2COpenAIPlugin is a ChatGPT plugin that generates diagrams with PlantUML or Mermaid from the conversation.

Features

  • Generate diagrams using PlantUML or Mermaid
  • Works as a ChatGPT plugin
  • Diagram-oriented UI

Installation

Before using the plugin, make sure to have the following prerequisites installed:

  • Python 3.6+
  • FastAPI
  • uvicorn
  1. Install Python 3.10, if not already installed.
  2. Clone the repository: git clone https://github.com/antoinebou12/D2COpenAIPlugin.git
  3. Navigate to the cloned repository directory: cd /path/to/D2COpenAIPlugin
  4. Install poetry: pip install poetry
  5. Create a new virtual environment with Python 3.10: poetry env use python3.10
  6. Activate the virtual environment: poetry shell
  7. Install app dependencies: poetry install
